transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because I think someone in the clinic system has been changing or holding back parts of my dad’s lab results. I’ve been trying to prove it for about a year. Everyone keeps telling me the numbers are fine, but the chart doesn’t match what I saw, and it’s wearing me down.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one was around to make them?
No, I haven’t heard voices or sounds that weren’t actually there.
Aside from feeling worn down by this, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed or hopeless. I’ve been stressed and tired from dealing with it, but I don’t feel down all the time.
Before this issue with your dad's records began, have you generally found it difficult throughout your life to trust other people?
I’m not sure. I mean, I’ve had normal concerns about people before, like anyone, but I wouldn’t say I’ve generally had trouble trusting everyone throughout my life.
Do you have any physical medical conditions or illnesses?
No, not that I know of. I don’t have any physical illnesses.
Have you ever felt like an outside force or person was putting thoughts into your head, taking them out, or controlling your actions?
No, I haven’t felt like someone was putting thoughts in my head or controlling what I do.
